about: P0 fixtures of the harness repair (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-23-evidence-bound-harness-repair.md). Each fixture keeps what 91a8c2d9 does (`baseline`, written by `fixtures.py record`) apart from what the spec asks (`expected`). Run with docs/research-log/harness-repair-2026-10-23/fixtures.py.

fixtures.scenario: A checked fact agent asks nothing; the legacy scale wait (one result for all samples, or one per sample) is kept. Regression of the 91a8c2d9 fix (keep-legacy-waits).

expected.note: the scale obligation stays open and is asked; an empty agent answer resolves nothing

rejected: R2 contract words not in its contract
legacy: Do you want one result for all your samples together, or one per sample?

fixtures.scenario: The agent asks the same fact as the legacy wait in other words (somatic or germline calls); the legacy wait is lifted as a shadow. Agent questions carry no fact key, so code cannot tell that the two are the same fact.

expected.note: the legacy obligation is discharged only with a reference to the agent question for the same fact key; otherwise it stays open

rejected: R6 the same words already ask a fact
legacy: Are these acquired somatic mutations, or inherited germline variants?

fixtures.scenario: The agent asks an unrelated BONOBO fact; the CONDOR network-kind wait is lifted and its row credited, so the regulator-gene answer is assumed. No clean recorded case: built as tests/test_fact_check.py builds it.

reasons: within and across the two layers

PANDA does not give it: the PPI network is an input of possible TF cooperation. PANDA refines a cooperativity matrix internally, but the executor does not save it, and it is not a measurement of physical complexes or stoichiometry.
